title: Charm target debuff sequence (Sequence)SEQ_Charm_Channel: particles observed, no beam drawn
summary: The target debuff AB_Charm_Channeling_Target_Debuff (-1760277810) carries one BuffSequence row, -541113174 = (Sequence)SEQ_Charm_Channel, whose asset list holds both Charm beam bodies, the loop/crown/cast particles and the capture material. Playing it through ctx.Effects.ServerBeamLink produced visible red swirl/crown particles at the player and no beam between the endpoints. A moving-endpoint Charm beam has NOT been verified; the required endpoint inputs are unresolved.
